The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Container Corporation of India Ltd ICD Tughlakabad Depot New Delhi Room no 106 CIFM . 4. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 3 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 5. Validity of Offer The quotation shall remain valid for 30 days from the date of quotation and no escala tion in prices would be acceptable to CONCOR. 3. Period of warranty: All batteries shall be covered under a warranty of two (02) years from the date of installation. During the warranty period, if any battery does not perform satisfactorily, the bidder sh all replace the faulty battery immediately at their own cost. The replaced battery shall be covered for the remaining period of the original warranty. The performance security amount shall be released afte r successful completion of the warranty period. 4. Support and Penalty Clause: During the Warranty period, in case of delay in delivery & installation of the UPS batteries, penalty will be imposed @0.5% of the value of the total value of the order, maxi mum penalty may be imposed upto 10% value of the contract value. 5. Performance Security Deposit: Within 30 days of the receipt of notification of award of the purchase order, the successful bidder shall furnish the Performance Security in form of Bank Guarantee equivalent of 5% of total purchase order/c ontract value valid upto end of 28 months from the date of purchase order. The BG Format shall be pr

ovided at the time of award of the order and the bidder shall Submit the performance bank guarantee in the same format. If the successful Bidder fails to submit the required Performance Security/SD declaration within 30 day s from the date of purchase order, extension of time for submission of Performance BG beyond 30 day s and upto 60 days of issue of purchase order may be given by the Accepting Authority. However, a p enal interest of 15% per annum of total BG value shall be charged for the delay beyond 30 days i.e. fr om 31st day after the issue of purchase order. The penalty shall be adjusted by demand draft submitt ed along with the BG. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite Performance Security even aft er 60 days from the date of issue of work order, the contract may be terminated duly forfeiting any a mount if payable to the bidder. In case the contract is terminated, the tenderer shall be debarred from participating in any tender/bid of CONCOR as per the terms and conditions of this tender/bid and /or th e policy of CONCOR. The delay in submission of the bank guarantee, extension of time as well as waiv er off of the penalty charges in case of late submission may be condoned by the tender/bid accepting Authority/CA if suitable satisfactory reasons for late submission are submitted by the vendor. 6. Payment Terms: a) No Advance payment shall be made. b) 100% payment shall be released after successful delivery, installation and commissioning of 12V/ 100AH SMF Online UPS’s batteries at Central Site (CIFM), lCD/TKD, New Delhi. (after LD deduction s if applicable) as per requirement of CONCOR. c) The vendor shall submit successful delivery and installation report duly signed by CONCOR officia l at the time of submission of invoice. d) Invoice shall be raised on CONCOR GST number 07AAACC1205A1ZP e) No charges for any additional item shall be payable by CONCOR. 7. Liquidity Damages Clause: If you fail to commission and integrate any or all of the equipment and the related services within the time period specified in the Purchase Order, CONCOR shall without prej udice to its other remedies available under Purchase Order, deduct from the Order price as liquidated damages, a sum equivalent to 0.5% (half of one percent) of the price of the delayed goods or unperfo rmed services for each week or part thereof, of delay until actual delivery or performance, upto a max imum deduction of 10% (ten percent) of order price. Once the maximum is reached, CONCOR may con sider cancellation of the Purchase order. 8. Signing of Contract: The Contract Agreement has to be signed by the successful Bidder within 20 days of receipt of Purchase Order, incorporating all agreements between the parties and bidder. The Contract Form is provided at Annexure-A. 9. Project Schedule: The Supply, Installation & Commissioning of 12V/100AH SMF Online UPS’s batteri es (under buyback) at CONCOR, Central Site, Tughlakabad within 3 weeks from the date of issuance of Purchase Order. The items have to be delivered and installed at the following address: O/o Manager (MIS), CONCOR Central Site, Room No 106,7,8 &10 Container Corporation of India Ltd. Inland Container Depot, Tughlakabad, New Delhi-110020 10. Technical Specification of battery: Nominal Voltage: 12V. Rated Capacity: 100AH. Type: Lead Acid Sealed Maintenance Free (SMF). 11.Scope of Work: a. The new batteries should be supplied at the central site/TKD within the given timeline. b. The batteries will be installed under the supervision of a trained engineer.

c. Along with batteries accessories such as thimbles, interconnecting cables, connectors, nut b olts etc. will be provided by vendor. d. All parameters should be checked before the installation of the new batteries. e. It should also be ensured that no UPS breaks down during the installation process. f. The additional batteries under the buyback scheme will be removed after completion of the installa tion. g. The date of manufacturing of the Battery to be installed should not be more than three months fro m the date of manufacturing to the date of installation. h. After successful installation of the new batteries, the engineer must sign the report and get it verifi ed by the CONCOR official. Without this verification, no payment shall be made. 12.Check list confirming Technical Specification of batteries: Make & Model of Storage: Specification Confirmation (Ye Remarks s/No) Voltage 12V Rated Capacity 100 AH Type Lead Acid Sealed Maintenanc e Free (SMF) As per instructions of DPE, Govt. of India, all MSME vendors / contractors are required to be onboar ded on TReDS Portal through their registration.
